say:1:1041575901:0.text: I didn't expect to see you again.

say:3:1041575903:0.text: The Wildborn... How are they now?

say:4:1041575904:0.text: If you truly cared, you would've returned long ago to stand guard over your homeland.
say:4:1041575904:0.source_cn: 若你真心在意雅库伯尔，就该回归故土，守卫这里。

say:5:1041575905:0.text: You are a winner of the Bloodhunt Festival, chosen by the Hunting Goddess. Protecting the tribe should have been your duty!
say:5:1041575905:0.source_cn: 你是猎血节的勇士，拥有神赐之力，护卫雅库伯尔本该是你的使命！

say:6:1041575906:0.text: Look at what the Wildborn have become under your command. The strong turn on the weak. Those who failed to become warriors were driven into Mirehold, left to starve.
say:6:1041575906:0.source_cn: 看看雅库伯尔在你的统治下变成了什么样子吧。强者与弱者敌...

say:7:1041575907:0.text: You were once worthy of being called a leader, Kordan... When did that change?
say:7:1041575907:0.source_cn: 戈丹，你曾经是一位称职的首领……为什么会变成现在这样？

say:8:1041575908:1.text: You have the nerve to ask? When we lost the goddess' favor, we were dragged into hardship.
say:8:1041575908:1.source_cn: 你还有胆子提……如果不是失去神佑，雅库伯尔怎么会面临困境？

say:9:1041575909:1.text: Without prey, there is no food, no survival.
say:9:1041575909:1.source_cn: 源源不绝的野兽、能够匹敌的猎物！有了这些，雅库伯尔才能...

say:10:1041575910:1.text: The Hunting Goddess demanded balance—prey neither too plentiful, nor hunters driven to extinction.
say:10:1041575910:1.source_cn: 狩猎神要猎手与猎物的平衡，既不会让猎物泛滥，也不会让猎...

say:11:1041575911:1.text: But she is gone. And the beasts of the jungle grew ever more ferocious. After so many warriors died on the battlefield, the Wildborn no longer have the strength we once did.
say:11:1041575911:1.source_cn: 但她陨落了……丛林中的野兽愈发凶猛。在那么多战士折亡于...

say:12:1041575912:1.text: You saw that carnage yourself. No one can deny it.
say:12:1041575912:1.source_cn: 那时的惨状你我亲眼目睹，谁也无法否认。

say:13:1041575913:1.text: If hunting has become a dead end, then hunt less. There must be other ways.
say:13:1041575913:1.source_cn: 既然狩猎艰难，那就减少狩猎，总有其他出路！

say:14:1041575914:1.text: Mirehold grows wheat in abundance. The tribe would not starve.
say:14:1041575914:1.source_cn: 而且水泽营地还种植着大量小麦。就算没有猎物，雅库伯尔也...

say:15:1041575915:1.text: Wheat is food for the weak, like Halians. Not for warriors!
say:15:1041575915:1.source_cn: 那是懦弱的呼临人的食物，不是战士的食物！

say:16:1041575916:1.text: Look at the Wildborn in Mirehold. Their claws are dull, their eyes lack hunger. They shrink back at the smell of blood alone!
say:16:1041575916:1.source_cn: 仔细看看水泽营地里那些家伙吧！他们的爪牙不再锋利，眼神...

say:17:1041575917:1.text: A Wildborn that stops hunting will rot from within, sooner or later! Comfort dulls the will faster than any blade.
say:17:1041575917:1.source_cn: 不再狩猎的雅库伯尔人，意志早晚会被安稳的生活磨灭！

say:18:1041575918:1.text: Exiling our own kin brought me no joy. But prey is scarce. It must be given to those still willing to fight, to forge new warriors.
say:18:1041575918:1.source_cn: 将同族赶出树怒山谷，我并不好过。但猎物有限，必须集中起...

say:19:1041575919:1.text: We need faith—a belief that binds our warriors together. Hunting, struggling against nature, facing trials and tempering ourselves, that is honor for us. It's the foundation of our strength and our tradition!
say:19:1041575919:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔需要信仰，需要让战士们团结的信念。狩猎，与自然...

say:20:1041575920:1.text: We may have lost our goddess, but I will lead us back to our purest path!
say:20:1041575920:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔失去了神，没错，但没关系，我会带领他们，回归雅...

say:21:1041575921:1.text: Spare me the righteousness. When you cast out the so-called weak, you showed no mercy. I watched it happen.
say:21:1041575921:1.source_cn: 别再狡辩了。你将所谓的弱者赶出树怒山谷时，可没有留半分...

say:22:1041575922:1.text: You know what happens on every hunt. Warriors die, again and again, while those who hide live safely and still take their share.
say:22:1041575922:1.source_cn: 那你也该知道，每次狩猎，每次出战，战士们死伤惨重。躲在...

say:23:1041575923:1.text: I know they have their uses. But should those bleed for our tribe not receive more than those who do not?
say:23:1041575923:1.source_cn: 我承认他们对雅库伯尔有用。可是冲锋陷阵、为雅库伯尔贡献...

say:24:1041575924:1.text: Even I cannot silence the resentment in the warriors' hearts.
say:24:1041575924:1.source_cn: 即便是我，也无法阻止战士们心生怨忿。

say:25:1041575925:1.text: I cannot ignore our last remaining fighters and let them leave with hatred in their hearts. The Wildborn would have no future.
say:25:1041575925:1.source_cn: 我不能枉顾雅库伯尔仅存的战士，让他们带着怨恨之心离去。...

say:27:1041575927:0.text: In my eyes, the "strong" and "weak" are equals. No one should be sacrificed for another.
say:27:1041575927:0.source_cn: 你所谓的强者和弱者，在我看来都是平等的。无论如何也不该...

say:28:1041575928:1.text: You are free to say that because you are not the one who must decide. I am.
say:28:1041575928:1.source_cn: 你不是首领，可以持中不言。但我不行。

say:29:1041575929:1.text: If my choices make me a sinner, so be it. But the Wildborn must survive. Even division is better than extinction!
say:29:1041575929:1.source_cn: 或许我会因自己的选择而成为另一些人眼中的罪人，但雅库伯...

say:30:1041575930:1.text: When the time comes, whether it's you or Gala who replaces me, judge me however you wish.
say:30:1041575930:1.source_cn: 到时候，你也好，加拉也罢。谁来取代我，如何评判我，随便你们。

say:32:1041575932:1.text: Perhaps your way preserves tradition... but I will never agree with you.
say:32:1041575932:1.source_cn: 也许你说的有一点道理，也许这的确能让雅库伯尔的传统得以...

say:33:1041575933:1.text: Then challenge me. Defeat me. Take this seat and lead the tribe your way.
say:33:1041575933:1.source_cn: 那么你就应该挑战我，击败我，成为新的首领，让雅库伯尔走...

say:34:1041575934:1.text: I have waited for someone to shoulder this burden. No one has been willing to bear this responsibility!
say:34:1041575934:1.source_cn: 我一直期待着有人来夺取这个首领之位，可惜没人愿意承担这...

say:35:1041575935:1.text: If you are dissatisfied, then challenge me—this so-called tyrant! Leadership is never simple, but I am the one who must make the hard choices.
say:35:1041575935:1.source_cn: 既然你不满，为什么不来挑战我这个暴君？当一个备受争议的...

say:36:1041575936:1.text: The Wildborns' blades are never meant for their own. That lesson stayed with me.
say:36:1041575936:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔的刀刃和箭矢绝不允许指向同伴——这是所有雅库伯...

say:37:1041575937:1.text: You may betray that creed. I will not.
say:37:1041575937:1.source_cn: 你可以违背它，但我不会。

say:38:1041575938:1.text: Betraying one's faith... Hmph. You have no idea how heavy that choice is.
say:38:1041575938:1.source_cn: 违背信念……哼，你不明白那有多煎熬。

say:39:1041575939:1.text: If Oboe were still here... perhaps I would not have hardened so. She would have reminded me what it means to lead with compassion. She embodied the Wildborns' true spirit—her skill, her courage, her heart—they were our greatest strength.
say:39:1041575939:1.source_cn: 要是欧布还活着……我希望她能看到过去雅库伯尔的荣光，她...

say:40:1041575940:1.text: But she will never return... so at the very least, I cannot allow those ideals to vanish. Our tribe must never fall!
say:40:1041575940:1.source_cn: 只可惜，她不会再回来了……那么，我至少不能让雅库伯尔的...

say:42:1041575942:0.text: Even if the name changes, belief survives as long as its people do.
say:42:1041575942:0.source_cn: 只要雅库伯尔人还在繁衍生息，哪怕部族的名号更替、改变，...

say:45:1041575945:1.text: I chose what I believed was loyalty—to the Wildborn.
say:45:1041575945:1.source_cn: 我，只是做了忠于雅库伯尔的决定。
